title: The Distant Silence
author: Kestrel Yarrow
blurb: Hazel Nakamura, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
